_note: Single list of the copy rules: read by lib/content/rules.ts (vitest) and by scripts/check-portfolio.mjs, so the two never diverge. `words` are matched as whole words, `phrases` as they are, `allowed` are the closed list of expressions removed before matching (the slogan verb 'entrega' is only allowed inside them).
_persons: First names of people: no fictitious person on the site (a scene shows the effect on a record, never a named person). Matched as whole words, case-sensitive, so the capitalised name only; names that are also Portuguese words (Rosa, Clara, Vitória...) are left out on purpose, to keep the check free of false positives.
_stack: The internal stack and the technical base of the products: never on the site (the platforms strip names only AWS, Google Cloud, DigitalOcean and HostDime). Matched as whole words, case-sensitive.
_known: Known failures the gate tolerates today, each with the phase of the v3 plan that removes it (control/portfolio/site-redesign/v3-plan/plano.md, section 5). The vitest fails when a tolerated value is no longer on the site, so this list only shrinks: delete the entry when its phase lands, never add one to make a check pass.
